subject: OrbitAI renewal: commitment refactor & invoice offset
messages:
From: Emma Jones <emma.jones@orbitai.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodai.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwoodai.com>
Cc: OrbitAI Finance <billing@orbitai.com>
Date: 2027-05-01T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Renewal planning — request for pricing guard & invoice offset

Hi Karthik / Priyom,

Thanks again for supporting OrbitAI through our pilot. We’re preparing our FY28 budget and want to lock in capacity for the primary production workload starting July. Two asks from finance and the engineering team:

- We plan to increase committed tokens by ~40% (across embeddings and chat) starting 2027-07-01.
- Because two feature launches slipped, OrbitAI is asking for an invoice offset (one-time credit) to cover the deployment delay costs — ideally applied to our July invoice.
- We’d like a short-term price hold on the committed rate for 3–6 months while we ramp.

I attached our March/April usage CSV so you can see the ramp profile. Can you share a proposed structure (credits, step-up schedule, and any overage protection) by EOW? We need a PO path and a suggested signature timeline to hit July start.

Emma
Emma Jones
Head of Platform
OrbitAI
Attachments: OrbitAI_Monthly_Usage_MarApr2027.csv

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodai.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwoodai.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwoodai.com>
Date: 2027-05-02T08:34:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Renewal planning — request for pricing guard & invoice offset

Looping you in. Quick summary of OrbitAI asks: +40% commit starting July, one-time invoice offset, 3–6 month price hold. Usage attached.

Proposed counter ideas (high level):
- Phased commitment refactor: quarterly true-ups for first 2 quarters (Jul–Sep, Oct–Dec) to align commit to actuals; this reduces upfront lock-in while giving them predictable unit pricing.
- Invoice offset: offer a 1-month invoice credit applied against July invoice (or equivalently, a one-time dollar credit tied to their average monthly spend) — conditional on a signed PO by 2027-06-15.
- Temporary price hold: 90 days guaranteed rate for committed units; after that we allow an adjustment tied to 90-day lagged consumption bands.
- Overage protection: cap overage rate at +30% of committed unit price for first 60 days; any excess billed at standard overage thereafter.

Operational asks: need OrbitAI finance contact (PO/FOB), confirm legal on short addendum for invoice credit. Priyom — can you draft a short term-sheet with the above bullets + a DocuSign placeholder? Lauren — can you lead outreach to Emma with the counter and MA POC?

Karthik
Director, Renewals
Redwood Inference

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwoodai.com>
To: Emma Jones <emma.jones@orbitai.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodai.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwoodai.com>, OrbitAI Finance <billing@orbitai.com>
Date: 2027-05-04T10:02:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Renewal planning — proposed commitment refactor + invoice offset (term sheet attached)

Hi Emma — thanks for the details and the usage file. I’ve drafted a short term-sheet and a simple mutual action plan below. Counterproposal condensed for review: 

Key commercial points (summary):
- Commit refactor: +40% nominal increase, implemented as two phased commits — 60% effective 2027-07-01, remaining 40% effective 2027-10-01 after a quarterly true-up.
- Invoice offset: one-time credit equal to 1x their May 2027 monthly invoice (applied to July invoice) once PO is received and countersigned by 2027-06-15.
- Price hold: 90-day price hold on committed units from effective date (Jul 1). After 90 days, commit unit price may adjust based on consumption band (we propose 3 bands; details in attached term sheet).
- Overage protection: first 60 days post-effective date capped at +30% unit price for any consumption above committed units.

Mutual action plan:
1) 2027-05-06 — OrbitAI to confirm finance PO contact and preferred billing entity.
2) 2027-05-10 — Redwood to share finalized term-sheet (attached) and DocuSign link.
3) 2027-05-20 — OrbitAI to return signed PO.
4) 2027-06-15 — Countersigned term-sheet by both parties; invoice credit applied in July billing.

Attachments: Counterparty_Term_Sheet_v3.pdf (details: consumption bands, true-up cadence, sample invoice credit calculation). DocuSign link included in the attached file’s cover page.

If the above aligns, we’ll route to legal for the short addendum and Ops for billing setup. If OrbitAI needs a larger offset amount or a longer hold, we should discuss trade-offs (e.g., longer commit term or a higher upfront commit).

Best,
Lauren Bishop
Principal Account Executive, Renewals
Redwood Inference

From: Emma Jones <emma.jones@orbitai.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwoodai.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodai.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwoodai.com>, OrbitAI Finance <billing@orbitai.com>
Date: 2027-05-05T16:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: RE: Renewal planning — proposed commitment refactor + invoice offset (term sheet attached)

Thanks Lauren — appreciate the clear plan. We’re generally aligned on the phased commit + true-up approach. Couple of asks from finance after reviewing the term sheet: 

- OrbitAI requests a 1.5x invoice offset (vs 1x proposed) to account for the two-month launch delay; this would be applied as a credit on the July invoice.
- Would Redwood consider a 6-month price hold instead of 90 days if OrbitAI can commit to the +40% nominal increase for a full 12-month term?

On the process side: billing contact is Mark Rosario (mark.rosario@orbitai.com) — I’ve cc’d billing. We aim to return the PO by 2027-05-18 if terms are agreed this week.

Quick note on quoting: "On Tue, May 4, 2027 at 10:02 AM Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwoodai.com> wrote:"
> Key commercial points (summary):
> - Commit refactor: +40% nominal increase, implemented as two phased commits — 60% effective 2027-07-01, remaining 40% effective 2027-10-01 after a quarterly true-up.
> - Invoice offset: one-time credit equal to 1x their May 2027 monthly invoice (applied to July invoice) once PO is received and countersigned by 2027-06-15.

We’ll sign if Redwood can move to 1.5x offset OR extend hold to 6 months with the 12-month commit.

Emma
